title: Weekly Reset
subtitle: hard-block worksheet
note: Ten minutes every Sunday. Be honest, keep it small, and remember: a hard block is temporary. If you've felt low for more than a couple of weeks, please reach out to your school's counseling or wellness services.

lines: ~One thing I'll drop or do lighter:
~My minimum on a bad day (reviews only? one lecture?):
~One thing that isn't medicine this week:
~One moment that reminded me why I chose this:

pins.title: How to Stay Motivated in Med School: A 10-Minute Weekly Reset
pins.description: Running on empty in a hard med school block? This 10-minute Sunday reset helps: look back honestly, list this week's must-dos, shrink the plan, schedule one thing that isn't medicine and ask for help early. Free printable worksheet from a fellow med student!

pins.quote: Make the plan smaller, not bigger
pins.headline: Then actually keep it
pins.title: Burned Out in a Med School Block? Shrink the Plan First
pins.description: When motivation is gone, adding more to your plan rarely helps. Decide your minimum for a bad day, drop one thing, and protect your sleep. Here's a simple weekly reset with a free printable worksheet. Be kind to yourself!
